patch.summary: Is Customer.io worth it? Customer.io is a product-led messaging platform for behavior- and event-driven campaigns across email, push, in-app, SMS, and related channels. Pricing is profile-based: Essentials from list price (5,000 profiles, 1M emails/mo researched), Premium from list pr…. Strong when Product-led teams sending event-driven multi-channel messages. Weak when Essentials from list price — not an SMB freemium ESP.

blocks.body: Customer.io earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Who Customer.io is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Customer.io when product-led, event-driven messaging is the primary job — not classic list-blast email marketing..

Avoid if: Compare Braze for enterprise B2C engagement, ActiveCampaign for SMB automation+CRM, Brevo/Mailjet for send-based ESP value, and Klaviyo for ecommerce-owned channels..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Braze on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.body:
